profile_text.body:
Asana is a publicly traded work and project management software company (ticker: ASAN, CIK: 0001477720) whose platform is designed, per its own site, to help teams and AI agents plan, automate, and execute workflows together. The company describes its approach as "Agentic Work Management," which it says brings together AI Teammates, AI Studio, Asana Dash, and MCP and AI Connectors so that human teams and software agents can run critical workflows in parallel.

The company's tracked AI product, Asana AI, covers work management, goal tracking, team productivity analytics, and data residency options. The site describes pre-built AI agents that operate inside existing workflows and draw on what it calls a "Work Graph," a shared memory layer that carries forward completed tasks, feedback, and preferences so that context does not have to be re-established each time. Users can also build custom AI Teammates intended to handle coordination-heavy work. The site quotes Simone Williams, identified as Chief Digital, Technology and Business Development Officer at COS, describing gains in visibility and speed from using the platform.

No litigation, MCP registry entries, or SEC filings beyond the basic public company registration appear in the held facts for Asana at this time.
